ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Hydra Password Bruteforce Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects command line parameters used by Hydra password guessing hack tool

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-p\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\^USER\\^.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\^PASS\\^.*")))
